# Pellows

> Short-stay marketplace for agencies + AI booking agents. Search live inventory, hold dates, pay in-app.

Pellows aggregates shortlet agencies (starting with Lagos). Guests and AI agents search one inventory and book with calendar truth.

## For AI agents

- Search live stays: `GET /api/v1/search?city=Lagos&checkIn=YYYY-MM-DD&checkOut=YYYY-MM-DD&guests=2`
- Tool catalog: `GET /api/v1/llm/tools`
- Invoke a tool: `POST /api/v1/llm/invoke` with `Authorization: Bearer $LLM_CHANNEL_SECRET`
- Never invent availability or prices — only use tool results
- After hold, send guests to `/pay/{paymentIntentId}` for card, bank, or crypto

## Public pages

- Home: `/`
- Search: `/search`
- Docs for humans: `/docs` is in the repo; product site pages grow as listings go live

## Optional

- Agency join (coming): `/join`
- Stay detail (coming): `/stays/{slug}`
